headline: 今日AI速览：学术研究最活跃
narrative:
今日共收录247篇AI新闻，分类分布：学术研究175篇, 开源项目42篇, 模型发布30篇。热门标签：Agent（59篇）。其中10%的文章有多来源交叉验证。

▸ morluto /rea：Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.

▸ cathrynlavery /diagram-design：Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, and Pi. 44 d

▸ pytorch /pytorch：Tensors and Dynamic neural networks in Python with strong GPU acceleration

▸ lyogavin /airllm：AirLLM 70B inference with single 4GB GPU

▸ OrcaRouter Releases OrcaCyber Zero 1.5 Cybersecurity Model With 1M Context：OrcaRouter released OrcaCyber Zero 1.5, a gated cybersecurity model with a 1M-token context window.
